hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' 2>/dev/null | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx oxlint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; *.rs) n=$(awk 'g{next} /#\[cfg\(test\)\]/{print NR-1; g=1} END{if(!g)print NR}' "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$n" -gt 400 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "file-size rule: $f has $n lines before #[cfg(test)] (limit 400) — extract modules; see .claude/rules/file-size.md" >&2; fi ;; esac; }; true
